{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Attempt to convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values that could not be converted
non_numeric_revenue = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isna() & df['revenue'].notna()]

# Display the problematic rows
non_numeric_revenue[['revenue', 'channel', 'converted']].head()"}
